text: Looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's 3 months old. Earlier she knocked her head on the edge of the table while I was holding her, she cried straight away and since then she's been completely normal, back to herself. But I've just taken her temperature and it's 39.9. I've been up with her for hours and I'm shattered and honestly not sure what I should be doing now. Her mum's away till tomorrow.
